The fix (one documented change to the encoding rule, no learned parameters): each bound line is now UNIT-NORMALIZED after the product, so every structural line contributes at O(1) scale and the structure dominates the input. The rule amendment is in RELATIONSHIP_ENCODER_001.md; the structural test verifies the rewire-vs-reorder contrast on balanced fake rows; 129 graph tests pass. STAGE 3 (only if mean after-loss < mean before-loss - 0.02): sealed validation/test evaluation with predictions before answers, plus familiar-example accuracy, reported separately. Deliverable: exactly one of LEARNED_AND_TRANSFERRED / LEARNED_NO_TRANSFER / DID_NOT_FIT / STAGE1_CHECK_FAILED, computed by a deterministic rule. No silent mid-run patches, no unlimited retries, no spending beyond this single job; the training pilot beyond this run stays pending.
